chain_words.nuance: willing to take a risk, often with confidence
ready to face danger or social disapproval
a general quality of facing fear or danger with courage
showing firm courage in a serious or difficult situation
courage of an exceptional kind, often sacrificing oneself for others

explanation: These words all describe courage, moving from a confident willingness to take risks to an exceptional, self-sacrificing bravery.

usage_notes.difference: 'Brave' describes a general quality of facing fear; 'heroic' describes an exceptional courage, often involving self-sacrifice for others.
